test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series will complete the series.

J_ _G_KP_ _ _PGJ
solution:
Given :- J_ _G_KP_ _ _PGJ

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) GJPKJK → J **G J **G ** P** K P **K J K** P G J

2) KJPGKJ → J **K J **G **P** K P **G K J **P G J

**3) KPJGJK → **J **K P **G **J **K P **G J K **P G J

4) PJKGJK → J **P J **G **K **K P **G J K **P G J

**Option (3) gives a pattern of** J K P G / J K P G / J K P G / J

Or, 

**Option (3) gives a pattern of **JKP - GJK - PGJ - KPG - J

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2030e7b1401eba4849a991eeed92aa964673ac3d9c0ab70fe079881608f2959.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is "**KPJGJK**".
